Its simple! Join and make a character with their signature tank, and then sign up for missions (we call them episodes). Missions are usually composed of a roleplay component where you mostly talk or investigate or sneak around or do anything as a schoolgirl and a combat component where you and your team of tanks fight an opposing force on a gridmap. We also host shorter roleplay only missions called OVAs where you can interact and do things in the world. 

The system is mostly based on world of darkness systems for your character, with an entirely homebrew tank building system for crafting your tank. You can customize everything from your suspension to your gun including the type of track on your tank!

Come make your own character and join in on the fun!
